title: Cheaper oil and foreign buying lift Sensex 773 points to 81,879.40; hot US inflation trims the rally
short: Sensex jumps 773 pts as oil cools; US inflation trims gains
dek: The Nifty closed at 25,255.05 after Brent fell to a two-month low and foreign investors kept buying. PSU banks and autos led, but hotter US inflation pulled the market off its highs.
